test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom given below:
"Hoist with one's own petard"

options.text: Be hurt by one's own scheme

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Be hurt by one's own scheme**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Hoist with one's own petard"** means to be harmed or defeated by one's own plan or device intended for others. (किसी व्यक्ति की अपनी योजना से उसे ही नुकसान होना) • **Example:** The hacker was hoist with his own petard when his computer got infected by the virus he created. • This phrase originates from the old use of the word "petard," which refers to an explosive device. It implies that the person setting the trap ends up being caught in it themselves. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Be hurt by one's own scheme**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Celebrate an early victory** (जल्दबाजी में जीत का जश्न मनाना) • **Example:** It is not wise to celebrate an early victory before the final results are announced. • **Option 3: Escape by clever trick** (चालाकी से भाग निकलना) • **Example:** The thief managed to escape by a clever trick before the police arrived. • **Option 4: Boost another's success** (दूसरे की सफलता को बढ़ावा देना) • **Example:** Mentors often boost their students' success by offering guidance and encouragement. 4c:Tf36, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 1** अर्थात् **अपनी ही योजना से चोटिल होना**।
